title: ReuseGR: Offline–Online Decoupled Generative Retrieval via Adaptive Prefix Reuse
topic: 离线前缀复用与在线个性化
code_status: 固定v1正文与arXiv链接未发现作者发布的ReuseGR源码；本文为西安电子科技大学与Alibaba AIDC合作
code_license: 作者源码未发现；论文CC BY 4.0；本地按公式独立实现

online_ab.traffic: 14-day user-level randomized production A/B, 10% traffic per arm, 0.5B E2E control; other retrieval/ranking/bidding fixed
online_ab.source_location: Section5.7 and AppendixD online statistics; RPM+1.05%, orders/request+0.78%, CVR-0.21%; complete-system paper results, not local evidence

cost_assessment.available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct planner and 0.5B-Instruct scorer/E2E fallback; LoRA64, PathKD then OPD/GRPO branch policy
cost_assessment.data_scale: about2M private query-item rows and3.38M catalog items; 947519 Fit rows, eight epochs, 14-day production A/B
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: private corpus/serving unavailable and repeated model training/benchmark matrix exceeds bounded component budget; paper uses oneA100 for latency measurement, not proof that complete training is cheap
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅CPU整行LOO深度标签、Wilson准则、缓存路由与复合分数，不训练任何模型

summary: 7B离线模型按query规划SID前缀，0.5B在当前用户历史下补全后缀；ReuseCut以历史覆盖选择复用深度，BudgetCut再学习集合相关的分支准入。本地只核深度标签/冷miss与准备好depth0的区别及分数接口，不把固定规则冒充学习的BudgetCut。
